summary: Two fractal-store cost tests run at a quarter of their history on pull requests: fleet_sized_document_reads_use_indexed_canonical_bindings_within_budget seeds 62,500 noise rows and 2,400 versions (was 250,000 and 10,000), and running_subagent_work_is_flat_when_expired_history_grows_tenfold grows expired history from 250 to 2,500 (was 1,000 to 10,000). The daily run (ST_TEST_SCALE=full) keeps the full sizes. A scan of the history still fails both at the smaller size.

replay.detail: Test only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run the full sizes on every pull request again.
